pr.body:
## Summary

Vendor the audit-honest Shadow verifier and dashboard into the Genesis demo.

## Tickets

Fixes #63

## Changes

- use weighted in-scope criterion maturity as the primary gauge
- separate automated observation results from criterion evidence state
- show Type I/II limitations and explicit report provenance
- add regression coverage that prevents the old audit-outcome claim

## Test Plan

- `cargo test --manifest-path .shadow/ci/Cargo.toml --locked`
- `cargo test --manifest-path .shadow/site/Cargo.toml --locked`
- rerun the deterministic dashboard workflow and inspect the published artifact
pr.title: Vendor audit-honest readiness dashboard
